Name: Maggs Skatepark Map Location
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

Ever wished the town had a skatepark? Well, now it does! This mod adds a map ﻿accessed via a bridge south of Sam's house. The map starts out as an open park area with some fishing and forage. After the event series building the skatepark, it appears in the center and has seasonal tilesheets.
[b]Note:[/b] once the skatepark is built, clear the weeds and debris or a few characters might get frustrated with you and not follow their normal schedule pathing.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768199442.png[/img]
4-part event series and dialogue, or instant build.
Option to disable any character's schedule change.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/201103991-1768199233.png[/img]
[b]Vanilla 6-Heart[/b]: A minor edit to the vanilla 6-heart event to introduce the skatepark project, not required for the mod to function if another mod overwrites the event.
[b]Skatepark Design[/b]: Sam 7 hearts, Saloon after 5 pm
[b]Town Project[/b]: unlocks 4 days after seeing Skatepark Design, Sam 7 hearts, Carpenter's Shop when Robin is there.
[b]Dream Park[/b]: unlocks 7 days after seeing Town Project, Sam 7 hearts, Skatepark, not rainy, 10 am - 5 pm.

[b]NOTE:[/b] the event conditions are different if you are running Immersive Sam Romance Core, you can find the conditions on the Immersive Sam Core mod description.
